description: Public NEXD SDK producer advisories for analytics.adcanvas.com/csc-event. Proprietary event data and checksum semantics remain unvalidated.

params.name: p
params.description: Party identifier emitted by the public SDK. IDs and custom event names are opaque; these are producer advisories, not a published rejection schema.

params.name: s
params.description: Session identifier emitted by the public SDK. IDs and custom event names are opaque; these are producer advisories, not a published rejection schema.

params.name: v
params.description: Page-view identifier emitted by the public SDK. IDs and custom event names are opaque; these are producer advisories, not a published rejection schema.

params.name: t
params.description: Arbitrary event type emitted by the public SDK. IDs and custom event names are opaque; these are producer advisories, not a published rejection schema.

params.name: a
params.description: Ad identifier emitted by the public SDK. IDs and custom event names are opaque; these are producer advisories, not a published rejection schema.

params.name: e
params.description: Per-page event identifier emitted by the public SDK. IDs and custom event names are opaque; these are producer advisories, not a published rejection schema.

params.name: c
params.description: Milliseconds timestamp is serialized with Number.toString(36) by the public SDK; fractional base36 is allowed. This check concerns finite numeric producer values.

params.name: i
params.description: Available screen width is serialized with Number.toString(36) by the public SDK; fractional base36 is allowed. This check concerns finite numeric producer values.

params.name: j
params.description: Available screen height is serialized with Number.toString(36) by the public SDK; fractional base36 is allowed. This check concerns finite numeric producer values.

params.name: k
params.description: Device pixel ratio is serialized with Number.toString(36) by the public SDK; fractional base36 is allowed. This check concerns finite numeric producer values.

params.name: w
params.description: Viewport width is serialized with Number.toString(36) by the public SDK; fractional base36 is allowed. This check concerns finite numeric producer values.

params.name: h
params.description: Viewport height is serialized with Number.toString(36) by the public SDK; fractional base36 is allowed. This check concerns finite numeric producer values.

params.name: n
params.description: The public SDK encodes new-party and new-session states as t or f.

params.name: f
params.description: The public SDK encodes new-party and new-session states as t or f.

params.name: l
params.description: The SDK truncates location.href to 1000 JavaScript UTF-16 code units. Supplementary characters occupy two code units.

params.name: r
params.description: The SDK copies document.referrer when set; its input string is preserved.

params.name: u
params.description: Optional SDK event data uses proprietary mincode serialization, not JSON. This value remains opaque.

params.name: x
params.description: When emitted by this SDK, x is the signed base36 checksum. The checksum computation and the absent-checksum historical branch are not validated.

params.name: method
params.description: The public SDK sends csc-event by assigning an Image src.
